metadata.description: Canonical library of reusable Claude Code skills, organized as plugins by install unit.

plugins.name: foundry-core
plugins.description: Core delivery discipline: evidence-report, proof-of-work, full-output-enforcement. Wanted on ~every project.

plugins.name: turn-reduction
plugins.description: Fewer wasted turns: capability-preflight, output-lint, standing-authorization, plan-gate.

plugins.name: data-wrangler
plugins.description: Data movement and matching: identity-resolution skill plus the data-pipeline-owner agent.

plugins.name: verification-kit
plugins.description: Verification helpers: fact-currency-check plus the pre-delivery-verifier agent.

plugins.name: consistency-checker
plugins.description: Spec-vs-artifact consistency: spec-artifact-diff plus the cross-document-checker agent.

plugins.name: deploy-ops
plugins.description: Deploy loop discipline: deploy-verify-fix and cloudflare-pages-migration plus the deploy-loop-owner agent.

plugins.name: decks
plugins.description: Build and critique slide decks: scaffolding, charts, HTML diagrams, PPTX export, layout and sales-lens review.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend visual design judgment: design taste, image taste, mobile app screens, minimalist UI, redesigns, and UI-polish review guidance.

plugins.name: long-projects
plugins.description: Keep work that spans many sessions on track: gated multi-phase project harnesses, session handoffs and retros, a review pipeline for routine changes, and second opinions on hard decisions.

plugins.name: project-starters
plugins.description: Start a new project properly: repo scaffolding with secret scanning, reproducible dev shells, a project knowledge base, and pipeline and systems design before any code.

plugins.name: agent-tooling
plugins.description: Choose the right model and effort level for a task, send bulk mechanical text work to a local model, and mine past session transcripts for facts.

plugins.name: voice-and-editing
plugins.description: One person's writing voice and editing tools, plus skills tied to the author's own machine and habits. Most useful as a pattern to fork: swap in your own voice, schedule and sources.
